王卓对于眼前的景象，也是怔在当场，许久后才缓过神，内心傲气不知觉的收敛了很多。
此时，又有几道长虹剑光临至，每道剑光消散后，都会现出恒岳派弟子，在他们的身边，毫无例外跟着几个十五六岁的少年。
这些人有男有女，在落下的一刻均都是如王林三人般，呆呆的望着眼前的景物，脸上表情不一。
带众人来此的恒岳派弟子零散的站在不远处，相互交谈打量这些少年。又等了一会，最终所有被推荐到此地的少年都来齐，此时黑衣中年人扫了一眼众人，声音不含任何感情，说道：“你们之中，只有极少的几个会被选中成为我恒岳派弟子。”
众少年寒蝉若惊，王林更是内心忐忑，他数了下，测试的一共48人。
“修仙，首重天资，接下来第一项测试，就是看你们灵根是否充足。现在我点到谁，谁就到我近前来。”中年人面无表情，随意的点了一个少年。
少年双腿微颤，小心翼翼的走了过去，中年人手按在少年头顶，淡然道：“不合格，到左面站好。”
少年似乎一下子失去了所有的力气，神情黯淡，眼带茫然的走到左边，沉默不语。
接着又一个少年被点中，忐忑不安的上前。
“不合格。”
“不合格。”
“不合格。”
连续十多个人，均都不合格，中年人的右边，到现在为止一个人都没有。
王卓被点中，他脸上傲气尽收，面色有些苍白，走上前。
中年人手放在王卓头上后，忽然面露喜色，语气温和，说道：“你叫什么名字？”
王卓连忙恭敬道：“回禀上仙，小子王卓。”
中年人点头，笑道：“原来你就是道虚师叔提到过的王卓，恩，到右边站好。”
王卓大喜，在所有人的羡慕目光中，走到右边，眼中傲气又现，轻蔑的望着众人，神情不可一世。

“妈的，他是走狗屎运了。”王浩撇了撇嘴，对王林低声道。
王林内心更加紧张，他眼前浮现父母期待的目光，握紧了拳头。
“不错，你也去右边站好。”中年人惊喜的声音传来，在他面前是一个少女。
时间过去不长，大部分少年都被测试完，可站在中年人右边的，只有两人。接下来，王浩被点中。
王浩一路小跑，站在中年人面前，还没等对方测试，立刻跪在地上重重的磕了几个响头，大声道：“上仙仙福永享，寿与天齐，小子王浩，您测试这么多人，一定很辛苦，要不您休息一会？我不着急，没事。”
中年人哑然失笑，测试了这么多人，均都是一脸紧张，惟独眼前这个少年虎头虎脑，最为机灵，居然还拍起了马屁。按在王浩头上，他摇头说道：“资质差些，不……”
王浩一听说自己资质不行，内心立刻跌至低谷，还没等对方说完，立刻从怀里拿出一个玉盒，双手交上，机灵的说道：“上仙，这是家父偶然间在山中得到，尝试多次都打不开，小子特地从家里带来，献给上仙您。”
中年人轻笑摇头，正要拒绝，但一扫玉盒，忽然瞳孔一阵收缩，抓起仔细一看，顿时面露喜色，说道：“不错，居然是一株有300年的灵芝，看这玉盒样子，应是被修真者封印在内，难怪你父亲打不开。”他语气一顿，略微沉吟，含笑道：“我身边缺个炼丹的小童，我看你比较机灵，可愿意做我小童？”
王浩立即惊喜起来，跌宕起伏的差异，让他激动不已，大声说道：“愿意，上仙，我愿意。”
中年人含笑点头，说道：“做我药童，也不会亏待你，可与其他弟子一样修炼门内仙术，你站在右边吧。”
王浩内心兴奋，跑到右边，得意洋洋的瞪了王卓一眼。
所有的失败者，均都面露惺惺之色，一个个催头丧气，更有甚者，已经泪流满面，哭泣不已。
中年人眉头一皱，喝道：“哭泣者，直接送走！”
站在不远处的恒岳派弟子，立即走出几人，抓起几个啼哭者，漫不经心的踏着剑光迅速消失。
中年人随手一指，点中王林。
王林深吸口气，紧张万分的走到中年人身边，他脑中一片空白，心里默默祈祷，眼前禁不住回想起父母期望的目光。
“我一定能被选中！”王林坚定的想到。
对方手一按，面无表情吐出三个让王林如坠冰窟的字。

Wang Zhuo was also stunned by the scene in front of him. It took him a long time to calm down, and his inner arrogance subsided a lot without realizing it.
At this time, several more Changhong Sword Lights arrived. After each sword light dissipated, disciples of the Hengyue Sect would appear. Beside them, there were without exception several young men of fifteen or sixteen years old.
These people were both male and female, and at the moment they fell, they were all like Wang Lin and the other three, staring blankly at the scene in front of them, with different expressions on their faces.
The disciples of the Hengyue Sect who had brought everyone here stood scattered not far away, talking to each other and looking at these teenagers. After waiting for a while, all the young men who were recommended here finally arrived. At this time, the middle-aged man in black glanced at everyone and said in a voice without any emotion: "Only a few of you will be selected to become my disciples of the Hengyue Sect."
The young people were shocked, and Wang Lin was even more worried. He counted a total of 48 people in the test.
"To cultivate immortality, the first priority is talent. The first test is to see if your spiritual roots are sufficient. Whoever I click on now will come to me." The middle-aged man had no expression on his face and randomly clicked on a boy.
The young man's legs trembled slightly and he walked over cautiously. The middle-aged man put his hand on the young man's head and said calmly: "If you are not qualified, stand on the left side."
The young man seemed to have lost all his strength all of a sudden, his expression was gloomy, his eyes were blank and he walked to the left, silent.
Then another boy was clicked, and he stepped forward uneasily.
"Unqualified."
"Unqualified."
"Unqualified."
There have been more than ten people in a row, all of whom have failed. So far, there is no one to the right of the middle-aged man.
Wang Zhuo was hit, his arrogance disappeared from his face, his face turned a little pale, and he stepped forward.
After the middle-aged man put his hand on Wang Zhuo's head, he suddenly looked happy and said in a gentle tone, "What's your name?"
Wang Zhuo quickly said respectfully: "Report to the Immortal, little Wang Zhuo."
The middle-aged man nodded and said with a smile: "So you are the Wang Zhuo that Uncle Daoxu mentioned. Well, stand on the right side."
Wang Zhuo was overjoyed. Under everyone's envious gaze, he walked to the right, his eyes arrogant again, and he looked at everyone with contempt, with an arrogant expression.
"Damn, he just got lucky." Wang Hao curled his lips and whispered to Wang Lin.
Wang Lin became even more nervous. His parents' expectant eyes appeared in front of his eyes, and he clenched his fists.
"That's right, you should go and stand on the right side." The middle-aged man's surprised voice came, and in front of him was a girl.
Not long ago, most of the teenagers had been tested, but there were only two people standing on the right side of the middle-aged man. Next, Wang Hao was hit.
Wang Hao trotted all the way and stood in front of the middle-aged man. Before the other party could test him, he immediately knelt on the ground and kowtowed heavily several times. He said loudly: "Immortals will enjoy eternal blessings and live as long as heaven. My dear Wang Hao, it must be very hard for you to test so many people. How about you take a rest? I'm not in a hurry. It's okay."
The middle-aged man burst into laughter. After testing so many people, they all looked nervous, but the young man in front of him was the smartest, and he even flattered him. Pressing on Wang Hao's head, he shook his head and said: "The qualifications are inferior, no..."
As soon as Wang Hao heard that his qualifications were not good, his heart immediately fell to the bottom. Before the other party could finish what he said, he immediately took out a jade box from his arms, folded it with both hands, and said smartly: "Shangxian, my father got this by accident in the mountains. He tried many times and couldn't open it. I brought it from home specially to dedicate it to you, Shangxian."
The middle-aged man chuckled and shook his head. He was about to refuse, but when he glanced at the jade box, his pupils suddenly shrank. He picked it up and took a closer look. He suddenly beamed with joy and said, "Yes, it is actually a 300-year-old Ganoderma lucidum. Judging from the appearance of this jade box, it must have been sealed by a cultivator. No wonderYour father can't open it. He paused, pondered a little, and said with a smile: "I am short of a kid who can make alchemy. I think you are smarter, would you like to be my kid?" "
Wang Hao was immediately pleasantly surprised. The ups and downs of the difference made him excited, and he said loudly: "Yes, I am willing to become an immortal. "
The middle-aged man nodded with a smile and said: "Being my medicine boy, I won't treat you badly, but you can practice the sect's magic like other disciples, so you should stand on the right side. "
Wang Hao was excited, ran to the right, and glared at Wang Zhuo triumphantly.
All the losers had a look of confusion on their faces and were dejected. What's more, some of them had tears streaming down their faces and were crying endlessly.
The middle-aged man frowned and shouted: "Send away those who cry! "
The disciples of the Hengyue Sect who were standing not far away immediately walked out, grabbed a few cryers, and quickly disappeared in the light of their swords.
The middle-aged man pointed his finger at Wang Lin.
Wang Lin took a deep breath and walked nervously to the middle-aged man. His mind went blank and he prayed silently in his heart. He couldn't help but recall the expectant eyes of his parents.
"I will definitely be chosen! "Wang Lin thought firmly.
The opponent pressed his hand and spat out three words with an expressionless face that made Wang Lin feel like he had fallen into an ice cave.
